text: くろい　きりを　だして　せんとうに　でている　ポケモン　ぜんいんの　のうりょくの　へんかを　もとに　もどす。

structure.jp: くろい　きりを　だして
structure.en: lets out a black mist and

structure.jp: せんとうに　でている　ポケモン　ぜんいんの
structure.en: of all the Pokémon that are out in battle

structure.jp: のうりょくの　へんかを

structure.en: puts back to how they were

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: せんとうに　でている　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing word describes it, like 'that' in English. せんとうに　でている　ポケモン = 'Pokémon that are out in battle'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. きりを　だして = 'lets out mist and'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a state that is still going on. でている = 'is out'.
